extracted.title: Nashik Ring Road and Trimbak Road widening approved at a review meeting
extracted.summary: The Maharashtra PWD reports that the Chief Minister and the Union Road Transport and Highways Minister reviewed Kumbh road preparations and approved key projects including the Nashik Ring Road and the widening of the Trimbak road. This is an approval, not a completion date.
